script.base: BUF is a 3-point home favorite off 14 days rest in a 55 total, so the base script is a mild shootout Buffalo leads late, about 29-26, not a blowout. Allen stays in the game as a runner (17/129 over weeks 4-6) but Cook (59 carries) handles the salt; Baltimore, on 7 days rest, stays within a score so Henry keeps an 18-20 carry role instead of a full abandon. Both QBs are blitz-proof enough (Allen EPA 0.35 blitz / 0.32 clean; BAL QB 0.34 blitz / 0.13 clean) that 31-35% blitz rates do not force a checkdown-only game.
script.flip1: Buffalo gets up by 14 early, feeds Cook and Allen on the ground, and the pass volume that Shakir, Coleman and Flowers need stalls the way a clock-kill stalls WR yards. Henry's carries die if Baltimore is the team chasing.
script.flip2: Baltimore jumps ahead or it becomes a true shootout: Allen's scramble rate climbs off the 17-carry L3, both passing games stay live, and Henry's rush line is the casualty if Baltimore leaves the run. A weather slog is the unlikely third path with wind under 15 in both pack figures.

Flowers (31 targets, 211 air, 256 yards) is Baltimore's primary into a Buffalo defense that allows 4.3 explosives a game, but 89.5 already sits on his 85-yard average, so the overlap is not a price edge.
